searchText: We haven't been recording. The idea was to have a very informal opportunity to bounce our stupidest questions around - ppl generally don't feel comfortable doing that when they're recorded. Are notes being kept in one place? We are each making individual notes in the cohort one github and <@818957367978885142> has started a light client R&D repo (https://github.com/ethereum-cdap/cohort-one/blob/master/notes/Light-Clients-R&D.md) where we are now starting to collectively pool info. Can I join too? <@!202397237962211328> please DM me if you are around ❤️ Certainly If you dm email I’ll try to add to invite sent friend req Is it still today 18UTC ? yep 👋 interested to join, will the zoom link be shared here prior to the call? yeah i'll make sure we post something here 😩 organizing a conference and they put the meeting at that exact time here I have an unrelated question about these zoom meetings. Is there any reason why they're not held directly here in this Discord server? Is there a lot of Spam? like using discord to host the call? no reason other than just what ppl are used to doing It sort of I feel that I'm lurking enough that I'd see people in a room called "light client call" and just jump in. Admittedly it's useless except for those that just want to hear there's no specific reason behind this except that it when it started it was just Jin and I chatting and we defaulted to Zoom. We can certainly change to discord if its the preferred option. Here is the zoom link.
